conf.description: ArcSight ESM (transitional) audit-events / csv-file: recommendations.direct.cribl (authoritative, high-side/no-guard) overrides the generic full-parse recipe -- pass the row through unparsed and tag event.dataset only; the header-bound CSV-to-ECS mapping is deferred to the Elastic-side logs-arcsight_esm.audit@custom ingest pipeline.

conf.comment: arcsight-esm / audit-events / csv-file. Per recommendations.direct.cribl: 'keep the low/core worker groups a pass-through and do not build an ArcSight CSV parser here - the same transitional logic as the CEF route, since this feed has a decommission date.' Signature-ID routing (authentication:/resource:/user:/actor:/activelist: prefixes) is already done upstream by the Forwarding Connector's own destination filter, so no per-row prefix logic is needed here. This pipeline therefore only tags event.dataset and leaves _raw (the full CSV row, header included) untouched for the Elastic-side header-driven CSV ingest pipeline to parse.
